literal: Emperor Xianzu Wenxuan, taboo name Yang, style Zijin, was Gaozu's second son and Shizong's younger maternal brother.
idiomatic: Emperor Wenxuan, temple name Xianzu of Northern Qi, bore the personal name Yang and the style Zijin. He was the second son of Gao Huan and the younger maternal brother of Gao Cheng.

literal: When the empress first conceived, every night red light filled the chamber; the empress privately found it strange.
idiomatic: When Empress Lou first conceived, every night red light filled the chamber; she privately found it strange.

literal: At first, when Gaozu went over to Erzhu Rong, the times were perilous and the household had nothing but bare walls; the empress and her kin sat facing one another, sharing fear of cold and hunger.
idiomatic: When Gao Huan first went over to Erzhu Rong, the realm was in turmoil and the household had nothing but bare walls; Empress Lou and her kin sat facing one another, sharing fear of cold and hunger.

literal: The Emperor was not yet able to speak, but suddenly answered "We will live"; the empress dowager and those beside her were greatly startled and dared not speak.
idiomatic: Gao Yang was not yet able to speak, but suddenly answered, "We will live." The empress and those beside her were greatly startled and dared not speak.

literal: When grown he was dark-skinned, with large cheeks and a long jaw; his body bore a scaly pattern and his ankles were heavy.
idiomatic: When grown he was dark-skinned, with large cheeks and a heavy jaw; his body bore a scaly pattern and his ankles were thick.

literal: He did not care for play and horseplay; he was deep and possessed great breadth of mind.
idiomatic: He cared little for play and horseplay; he was reserved and possessed great breadth of mind.

literal: At Jinyang there was once a monk who seemed by turns foolish and wise; men could not fathom him and called him Master Atuo.
idiomatic: At Jinyang there was once a monk who seemed by turns foolish and wise; men could not fathom him and called him Master Atuo.

literal: The Emperor once went with other boys to see him; the monk asked each man's destined rank in turn, and when it came to the Emperor he only raised his hand and pointed repeatedly at heaven, saying nothing with his mouth.
idiomatic: Gao Yang once went with other boys to see him; the monk asked each boy's destined rank in turn, and when it came to Gao Yang he only raised his hand and pointed repeatedly at heaven, saying nothing.

literal: Those who saw this thought it strange.
idiomatic: Those who saw it thought it strange.

literal: Gaozu once tested his sons' dispositions, giving each a snarl of tangled silk to put in order; the Emperor alone drew a knife and cut it, saying: "What is tangled must be cut.
idiomatic: Gao Huan once tested his sons' dispositions, giving each a snarl of tangled silk to put in order; Gao Yang alone drew a knife and cut it, saying, "What is tangled must be cut.

literal: " Gaozu approved of this.
idiomatic: " Gao Huan approved of this.

literal: Again he gave each men-at-arms to lead out in four directions, and sent armored cavalry to feign attack.
idiomatic: Again he gave each son troops to lead out in four directions and sent armored cavalry to feign attack.

literal: Shizong and the others were frightened and broke; the Emperor mustered his forces and fought Peng Yue as enemy, and though Peng removed his helmet and spoke from the heart, the Emperor still captured him and presented him as captive.
idiomatic: Gao Cheng and the others were frightened and broke; Gao Yang mustered his forces and fought Peng Yue as an enemy, and though Peng removed his helmet and spoke from the heart, Gao Yang still captured him and presented him as captive.

literal: Later, following Shizong in passing Mount Liaoyang, he alone saw the Gate of Heaven open; no one else saw it.
idiomatic: Later, following Gao Cheng in passing Mount Liaoyang, he alone saw the Gate of Heaven open; no one else saw it.

literal: Inwardly he was keen and sharp, yet in appearance he seemed deficient; Shizong often sneered at him, saying: "This man too will come to wealth and rank — how is face-reading to be explained.
idiomatic: Inwardly he was keen and sharp, yet in appearance he seemed deficient; Gao Cheng often sneered at him, saying, "This man too will come to wealth and rank — how is face-reading to be explained?

literal: " Only Gaozu regarded him differently and said to Xue Shu: "This boy's understanding surpasses mine.
idiomatic: " Only Gao Huan regarded him differently and said to Xue Shu, "This boy's understanding surpasses mine.

literal: " In youth he studied under Lu Jingyu of Fanyang; his retentive memory surpassed others, and Jingyu could not fathom him.
idiomatic: " In youth he studied under Lu Jingyu of Fanyang; his retentive memory surpassed others, and Jingyu could not fathom him.

literal: In the second year of Tianping he was given Regular Palace Attendant, General of the Flying Cavalry, Lord Equal to Three Imperator, Left Grand Master of Splendor, and Duke of Taiyuan Commandery.
idiomatic: In Tianping 2 (535) he received Regular Palace Attendant, General of the Flying Cavalry, Lord Equal to Three Imperator, Left Grand Master of Splendor, and the dukedom of Taiyuan Commandery.

literal: In the first year of Wuding he was given Palace Attendant.
idiomatic: In Wuding 1 (543) he was made Palace Attendant.

literal: In the second year he was transferred to Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General of the Palace Guard.
idiomatic: In the second year he was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General of the Palace Guard.

literal: In the fifth year he was given Director of the Masters of Writing, Director of the Secretariat Supervisor, and Grand Commander of the Capital Region.
idiomatic: In the fifth year he received Director of the Masters of Writing, Director of the Secretariat Supervisor, and the grand command of the capital region.

literal: In the eighth month of the seventh year of Wuding, Shizong was murdered; the affair was sudden and within and without all were shaken.
idiomatic: In the eighth month of Wuding 7 (549), Gao Cheng was murdered; the affair was sudden and within and without all were shaken.

literal: The Emperor's expression did not change; he directed the ranks, personally cut up the band of rebels and lacquered their heads, and slowly proclaimed: "The slaves have rebelled; the Grand General is wounded — there is no great harm.
idiomatic: Gao Yang's expression did not change; he directed the ranks, personally cut up the band of rebels and lacquered their heads, and slowly proclaimed, "The slaves have rebelled; the Grand General is wounded — there is no great harm.

literal: " At the time none within or without was not startled.
idiomatic: " At the time none within or without was not startled.

literal: He then went to Jinyang, personally overseeing general government, striving for clemency; matters that were inconvenient were all exempted or reduced.
idiomatic: He then went to Jinyang, personally overseeing general government and striving for clemency; matters that were inconvenient were all exempted or reduced.

literal: In the tenth month, on the first day guimwei, Prince of Xianyang Tan was made Grand Tutor and Pan Xiangle was made Minister of Works.
idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the first day guimwei, Prince of Xianyang Gao Tan was made Grand Tutor and Pan Xiangle was made Minister of Works.

literal: In the eleventh month, on wuwu day, the Tuyuhun state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuwu day, the Tuyuhun state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Liang's Inspector of Qizhou Mao Lingbin, Inspector of Dezhou Liu Lingdui, and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou Huangfu Shen and others all submitted their provinces within.
idiomatic: Liang's Qizhou Inspector Mao Lingbin, Dezhou Inspector Liu Lingdui, and Southern Yuzhou Inspector Huangfu Shen and others all submitted their provinces.

literal: In the twelfth month, on jiyou day, Bing Inspector Peng Yue was made Minister of Education and Grand Tutor Helou Ren was made Bing Inspector.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiyou day, Bing Inspector Peng Yue was made Minister of Education and Grand Tutor Helou Ren was made Bing Inspector.

literal: In the first month of spring in the eighth year, on gengshen day, Liang's Inspector of Chuzhou Song Angu submitted his province within.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the eighth year, on gengshen day, Liang's Chuzhou Inspector Song Angu submitted his province.

literal: On xinyou day the Wei Emperor held mourning for Shizong in the Eastern Hall.
idiomatic: On xinyou day the Eastern Wei emperor held mourning for Gao Cheng in the Eastern Hall.

literal: Liang's Inspector of Dingzhou Tian Congneng, Inspector of Hongzhou Zhang Xian, and others submitted their provinces within.
idiomatic: Liang's Dingzhou Inspector Tian Congneng, Hongzhou Inspector Zhang Xian, and others submitted their provinces.

literal: On wuchen day the Wei edict advanced the Emperor to Bearer of Credentials, Grand Chancellor, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, Grand Mobile Headquarters, Prince of Qi Commandery, with a fief of ten thousand households.
idiomatic: On wuchen day the Eastern Wei emperor edicted that Gao Yang be advanced to Bearer of Credentials, Grand Chancellor, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, Grand Mobile Headquarters, and Prince of Qi Commandery, with a fief of ten thousand households.

literal: On jiaxu day the Didouyu state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Didouyu state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: In the third month, on xinyou day, he was further enfeoffed as Prince of Qi, with the five commanderies of Bohai, Changle, Ande, and Wuyi in Jizhou and Hejian in Yingzhou, a fief of one hundred thousand households.
idiomatic: In the third month, on xinyou day, he was further enfeoffed as Prince of Qi, with the five commanderies of Bohai, Changle, Ande, and Wuyi in Jizhou and Hejian in Yingzhou — a fief of one hundred thousand households.

literal: From the time he dwelt at Jinyang, his sleeping chamber at night had light like day.
idiomatic: From the time he dwelt at Jinyang, his sleeping chamber at night had light like day.

literal: Once he was made prince, he dreamed that a man with a brush dotted his forehead.
idiomatic: Once he was made prince, he dreamed that a man with a brush dotted his forehead.

literal: At dawn he told his guest Wang Tanzhe: "Am I to withdraw?
idiomatic: At dawn he told his guest Wang Tanzhe, "Am I to withdraw?

literal: " Tanzhe bowed twice and congratulated him: "When the character for 'prince' receives a dot, it becomes the character for 'lord' — you are to advance.
idiomatic: " Wang Tanzhe bowed twice and congratulated him, "When the character for 'prince' receives a dot, it becomes the character for 'lord' — you are to advance.

literal: " In the fifth month of summer, on xinhai day, the Emperor went to Ye.
idiomatic: " In the fifth month of summer, on xinhai day, Gao Yang went to Ye.

literal: On jiayin day he was advanced to Grand Chancellor, oversaw all affairs of state, and enfeoffed with the ten commanderies of Bohai, Changle, Ande, and Wuyi in Jizhou, Hejian, Gaoyang, and Zhangwu in Yingzhou, and Zhongshan, Changshan, and Boling in Dingzhou, a fief of two hundred thousand households, with the Nine Bestowals and extraordinary honors, remaining Prince of Qi as before.
idiomatic: On jiayin day he was advanced to Grand Chancellor, given charge of all affairs of state, and enfeoffed with the ten commanderies of Bohai, Changle, Ande, and Wuyi in Jizhou, Hejian, Gaoyang, and Zhangwu in Yingzhou, and Zhongshan, Changshan, and Boling in Dingzhou — a fief of two hundred thousand households — with the Nine Bestowals and extraordinary honors, remaining Prince of Qi as before.

literal: The Wei Emperor sent Acting Grand Commandant Prince of Pengcheng Shao and Minister of Works Pan Xiangle to invest him with the edict, saying:
idiomatic: The Eastern Wei emperor sent Acting Grand Commandant Prince of Pengcheng Gao Shao and Minister of Works Pan Xiangle to invest him with the edict, saying:

literal: Alas!
idiomatic: Alas!

literal: Attend and hear Our command: Heaven alone is great — it arrays the sun and stars and hangs forth signs;
idiomatic: Attend and hear Our command: Heaven alone is great — it arrays the sun and stars and hangs forth signs;

literal: Earth is said to be thick — it opens rivers and mountains to enrich the myriad things.
idiomatic: Earth is said to be thick — it opens rivers and mountains to enrich the myriad things.

literal: Thus the four seasons succeed one another, the myriad kinds throng together, the common multitude find their nature, and every form is spared untimely death.
idiomatic: Thus the four seasons succeed one another, the myriad kinds throng together, the common multitude find their nature, and every form is spared untimely death.

literal: Then the sovereign and king inherit the calendar, gaze deeply from on high, hold silence and let the robe hang, and entrust accomplishment to teacher and minister — thus the Earl of Xia and the Yin minister gave their utmost as arms and legs, and King Cheng of Zhou and Emperor Zhao of Han ruled through nonaction.
idiomatic: Then the sovereign and king inherit the calendar, gaze deeply from on high, hold silence and let the robe hang, and entrust accomplishment to teacher and minister — thus the Earl of Xia and the Yin minister gave their utmost as arms and legs, and King Cheng of Zhou and Emperor Zhao of Han ruled through nonaction.

literal: Lately the realm has been full of hardship and the fate of the state hangs like a pendant — then Our founding enterprise was about to fall to earth.
idiomatic: Lately the realm has been full of hardship and the fate of the state hangs like a pendant — then Our founding enterprise was about to fall to earth.

literal: Prince Xianwu of Qi rose swiftly amid wind and cloud, greatly rescued peril and crisis, supported Our person, and remade the state, managing the common soil to the point of utmost toil and care.
idiomatic: Prince Xianwu of Qi rose swiftly amid wind and cloud, greatly rescued peril and crisis, supported Our person, and remade the state, managing the common soil to the point of utmost toil and care.

literal: When Wenxiang took up the structure, he broadened the former enterprise still further, settled the state and smoothed hardship, and his Way reached the azure vault.
idiomatic: When Gao Cheng took up the structure, he broadened the former enterprise still further, settled the state and smoothed hardship, and his Way reached the azure vault.

literal: The Prince accumulates virtue and answers the age — once in a thousand generations; subtle in foresight, deep in counsel, divine in spirit and sage in holiness, he greatly exalts hegemonic virtue and truly broadens the minister's design.
idiomatic: The Prince accumulates virtue and answers the age — once in a thousand generations; subtle in foresight, deep in counsel, divine in spirit and sage in holiness, he greatly exalts hegemonic virtue and truly broadens the minister's design.

literal: Though hidden merit and subtle reality lie beyond words and images, to set forth fame and show the trace, ritual and canon ought to be proclaimed.
idiomatic: Though hidden merit and subtle reality lie beyond words and images, to set forth fame and show the trace, ritual and canon ought to be proclaimed.

literal: Now We renew the later command — reverently receive it in emptiness.
idiomatic: Now We renew the later command — reverently receive it in emptiness.

literal: When the Prince first raised the wind and planted his banner on the upper land, sheltering the people and establishing government, timely rain poured in torrents; those below knew shame and integrity, benevolence was added to land and water, customs were changed and manners transformed — from Qi to Lu — this is the Prince's merit.
idiomatic: When the Prince first raised the wind and planted his banner on the upper land, sheltering the people and establishing government, timely rain poured in torrents; those below knew shame and integrity, benevolence was added to land and water, customs were changed and manners transformed — from Qi to Lu — this is the Prince's merit.

literal: Still he held the Celestial Terrace and took part in all military law; plans issued like a god and awe ran over the northern soil; bow drawn, the enemy fled and the pine frontier knew no smoke — this too is the Prince's merit.
idiomatic: Still he held the Celestial Terrace and took part in all military law; plans issued like a god and awe ran over the northern soil; bow drawn, the enemy fled and the pine frontier knew no smoke — this too is the Prince's merit.

literal: He continued the former thread of light, held the balance and set right the realm; Chinese and barbarian were mixed into one, winds and seas were tuned and the barbarians settled; sun and moon shed their brilliance, heaven and earth were clear and tranquil; sound met echo and none who thought did not submit — this too is the Prince's merit.
idiomatic: He continued the former thread of light, held the balance and set right the realm; Chinese and barbarian were mixed into one, winds and seas were tuned and the barbarians settled; sun and moon shed their brilliance, heaven and earth were clear and tranquil; sound met echo and none who thought did not submit — this too is the Prince's merit.

literal: Far off the fiery south, long in violation of the correct calendar, cherishing letters and displaying martial power, he handed down strategy and declared the rule; cities of Huai and Chu linked together fell like frost and mulberry leaves — this too is the Prince's merit.
idiomatic: Far off the fiery south, long in violation of the correct calendar, cherishing letters and displaying martial power, he handed down strategy and declared the rule; cities of Huai and Chu linked together fell like frost and mulberry leaves — this too is the Prince's merit.

literal: Guan and Xian were his girdle and sash; he strode over desolation; in the land that was the realm's belly, peaks stood and owls perched; a partial force had only to point and they melted like ice scattered — this too is the Prince's merit.
idiomatic: Guan and Xian were his girdle and sash; he strode over desolation; in the land that was the realm's belly, peaks stood and owls perched; a partial force had only to point and they melted like ice scattered — this too is the Prince's merit.

literal: Where Jinxi lay, steep beside river and thunder, far separated from sound and teaching and lost in direction unchanged, he ordered generals to marshal troops, overturned their nests, and with martial prestige wind-swift overawed the southern sea — this too is the Prince's merit.
idiomatic: Where Jinxi lay, steep beside river and thunder, far separated from sound and teaching and lost in direction unchanged, he ordered generals to marshal troops, overturned their nests, and with martial prestige wind-swift overawed the southern sea — this too is the Prince's merit.

literal: The many barbarians were overbearing, severed from the southern frontier for generations, shaking the border marches and repeatedly becoming dust and stubble; cherishing virtue and fearing awe, they turned to the wind and asked to submit; leaning corners all fell, arriving like clouds — this too is the Prince's merit.
idiomatic: The many barbarians were overbearing, severed from the southern frontier for generations, shaking the border marches and repeatedly becoming dust and stubble; cherishing virtue and fearing awe, they turned to the wind and asked to submit; leaning corners all fell, arriving like clouds — this too is the Prince's merit.

literal: Barbarians of another kind spread through mountain valleys; chieftains of ten thousand clans over a thousand li relied on peril and were not respectful, indulging their fierceness and cunning; delighting in pure custom, they came together bearing tribute, and grain and silk levies filled the princely storehouse — this too is the Prince's merit.
idiomatic: Barbarians of another kind spread through mountain valleys; chieftains of ten thousand clans over a thousand li relied on peril and were not respectful, indulging their fierceness and cunning; delighting in pure custom, they came together bearing tribute, and grain and silk levies filled the princely storehouse — this too is the Prince's merit.

literal: Across the boundless sea, age-long foes of the many Chinese, wind-borne and bird-swift, coming suddenly and going suddenly — having drunk rich wine they clung like lacquer; fur coats piled by the ren, strange beasts led by the tail — this too is the Prince's merit.
idiomatic: Across the boundless sea, age-long foes of the many Chinese, wind-borne and bird-swift, coming suddenly and going suddenly — having drunk rich wine they clung like lacquer; fur coats piled by the ren, strange beasts led by the tail — this too is the Prince's merit.

literal: Qinchuan was still blocked, making itself Our foe; then they drew pepper and orchid and sent letters asking for friendship; heaven moved their inmost hearts, their words were humble and their rites thick; the realm was settled and quiet, far and near all arrived — this too is the Prince's merit.
idiomatic: Qinchuan was still blocked, making itself Our foe; then they drew pepper and orchid and sent letters asking for friendship; heaven moved their inmost hearts, their words were humble and their rites thick; the realm was settled and quiet, far and near all arrived — this too is the Prince's merit.

literal: The southern Yang reported calamity and the people had nowhere to turn; sons and younger brothers of the Xiao house still sought one another's shelter, like birds returning to mountains and streams running to the sea; ten districts of Jing and Jiang in a moment offered themselves cut away; seizing this occasion, he would mix Zhu and Fang — this too is the Prince's merit.
idiomatic: The southern Yang reported calamity and the people had nowhere to turn; sons and younger brothers of the Xiao house still sought one another's shelter, like birds returning to mountains and streams running to the sea; ten districts of Jing and Jiang in a moment offered themselves cut away; seizing this occasion, he would mix Zhu and Fang — this too is the Prince's merit.

literal: Heaven level and earth complete, all under heaven flourishing; auspicious tokens appeared clearly and the scribes' brushes did not cease; connected trees numbered a hundred, and nine-tailed beasts appeared together; white surpassed the Qin sparrow, azure matched the Zhou crow — this too is the Prince's merit.
idiomatic: Heaven level and earth complete, all under heaven flourishing; auspicious tokens appeared clearly and the scribes' brushes did not cease; connected trees numbered a hundred, and nine-tailed beasts appeared together; white surpassed the Qin sparrow, azure matched the Zhou crow — this too is the Prince's merit.

literal: He searched storehouses and promoted men of office; caps and robes received order; rites and music, long sunken, were both revived; light corvée and abolished levies, pity in prisons and lenient punishments, great faith shown abroad and deep benevolence reaching far — this too is the Prince's merit.
idiomatic: He searched storehouses and promoted men of office; caps and robes received order; rites and music, long sunken, were both revived; light corvée and abolished levies, pity in prisons and lenient punishments, great faith shown abroad and deep benevolence reaching far — this too is the Prince's merit.

literal: The Prince has the great merit of settling the realm beneath the sun, and in addition displays the overflowing virtue of bright light; proclaim and assist the grand design, to stand at Our left and right in speech.
idiomatic: The Prince has the great merit of settling the realm beneath the sun, and in addition displays the overflowing virtue of bright light; proclaim and assist the grand design, to stand at Our left and right in speech.

literal: In former times the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao were divided without, Mao and Bi entered to assist — the charge within and without the Prince ought to sum them.
idiomatic: In former times the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao were divided without, Mao and Bi entered to assist — the charge within and without the Prince ought to sum them.

literal: Human counsel and ghost counsel, the two principles in accord — the bestowal of command proceeds, righteousness declaring the public Way.
idiomatic: Human counsel and ghost counsel, the two principles in accord — the bestowal of command proceeds, righteousness declaring the public Way.

literal: Because the Prince treads law and steps in ritual, setting the standard for the myriad living, round heads rest in will and lead hearts return to the Way, therefore We bestow upon the Prince the Great Road and War Road, one each, with black stallions four-in-hand, two teams.
idiomatic: Because the Prince treads law and steps in ritual, setting the standard for the myriad living, round heads rest in will and lead hearts return to the Way, therefore We bestow upon the Prince the Great Road and War Road, one each, with black stallions four-in-hand, two teams.

literal: The Prince deeply weighs the people as heaven and takes the root as his task; clothing and food are the source of honor and disgrace — therefore We bestow upon the Prince the robe and cap of the nine emblems, with red slippers besides.
idiomatic: The Prince deeply weighs the people as heaven and takes the root as his task; clothing and food are the source of honor and disgrace — therefore We bestow upon the Prince the robe and cap of the nine emblems, with red slippers besides.

literal: The Prince deeply broadens kindness and harmony, easily tunes wind and transformation; spirits and gods draw near and merit and virtue can be imaged — therefore We bestow upon the Prince suspended music and the dance of six rows.
idiomatic: The Prince deeply broadens kindness and harmony, easily tunes wind and transformation; spirits and gods draw near and merit and virtue can be imaged — therefore We bestow upon the Prince suspended music and the dance of six rows.

literal: The Prince's fame and sound shake brilliantly and the nine regions are all soothed; distant men lead and submit, running to present gifts — therefore We bestow upon the Prince vermilion doors to dwell in.
idiomatic: The Prince's fame and sound shake brilliantly and the nine regions are all soothed; distant men lead and submit, running to present gifts — therefore We bestow upon the Prince vermilion doors to dwell in.

literal: The Prince seeks the worthy and selects the multitude, exhausting the grass and thickets; presenting strength and taking rank, none are not the right men — therefore We bestow upon the Prince the ascending steps to mount.
idiomatic: The Prince seeks the worthy and selects the multitude, exhausting the grass and thickets; presenting strength and taking rank, none are not the right men — therefore We bestow upon the Prince the ascending steps to mount.

literal: The Prince's heroic design and fierce breadth restrain and raise a thousand kinds; resolute in season, correcting what is and is not — therefore We bestow upon the Prince three hundred martial guards.
idiomatic: The Prince's heroic design and fierce breadth restrain and raise a thousand kinds; resolute in season, correcting what is and is not — therefore We bestow upon the Prince three hundred martial guards.

literal: The Prince is tied to rise and fall; he sets the utmost limit of dark and bright, corrects heaven's punishment, and the guilty all are taken — therefore We bestow upon the Prince axe and yue, one each.
idiomatic: The Prince is tied to rise and fall; he sets the utmost limit of dark and bright, corrects heaven's punishment, and the guilty all are taken — therefore We bestow upon the Prince axe and yue, one each.

literal: The Prince is hawk-soaring and leopard-changing, truly supporting the lower soil; wolf-looking and owl-spreading, none are not shot down — therefore We bestow upon the Prince one red bow, one hundred red arrows, ten black bows, and one thousand black arrows.
idiomatic: The Prince is hawk-soaring and leopard-changing, truly supporting the lower soil; wolf-looking and owl-spreading, none are not shot down — therefore We bestow upon the Prince one red bow, one hundred red arrows, ten black bows, and one thousand black arrows.

literal: The Prince's filial piety reaches utmost and passes through to the spirits; leading the people to rise and act, feeling reaches the regions — therefore We bestow upon the Prince one jar of black millet ale, with jade libation cup and ladle besides.
idiomatic: The Prince's filial piety reaches utmost and passes through to the spirits; leading the people to rise and act, feeling reaches the regions — therefore We bestow upon the Prince one jar of black millet ale, with jade libation cup and ladle besides.

literal: Go — reverence!
idiomatic: Go — reverence!

literal: Reverently follow the former register, preserve and assist the royal house, to the end employ your fine virtue, and respond to and raise Our Grand Ancestor's bright command.
idiomatic: Reverently follow the former register, preserve and assist the royal house, to the end employ your fine virtue, and respond to and raise Our Grand Ancestor's bright command.

literal: Because the mandate of heaven and the people's hope had a place to return, on bingchen day the Wei Emperor issued an edict, saying:
idiomatic: Because the mandate of heaven and the people's hope had a place to return, on bingchen day the Eastern Wei emperor issued an edict, saying:

literal: The three powers were divided and distinguished, a hundred kings rose in succession, governing heaven and quieting earth, harmonizing spirits and revering ghosts, sheltering the people and creating things — all from numinous tokens; not one man's great treasure, but truly the sacred vessel of the Way.
idiomatic: The three powers were divided and distinguished, a hundred kings rose in succession, governing heaven and quieting earth, harmonizing spirits and revering ghosts, sheltering the people and creating things — all from numinous tokens; not one man's great treasure, but truly the sacred vessel of the Way.

literal: In former times Our clan ancestors answered the age and suddenly unified one region; sage after sage doubled the light, down to the ninth leaf.
idiomatic: In former times Our clan ancestors answered the age and suddenly unified one region; sage after sage doubled the light, down to the ninth leaf.

literal: Virtue did not continue; still we departed from peril and ruin; those who stole names filled the nine domains, those who usurped command were not limited to the Three Dukes; the lord was killed, the court endangered, human and divine had no tie — the great realm would no longer be Wei's.
idiomatic: Virtue did not continue; still we departed from peril and ruin; those who stole names filled the nine domains, those who usurped command were not limited to the Three Dukes; the lord was killed, the court endangered, human and divine had no tie — the great realm would no longer be Wei's.

literal: We relied on Prince Xianwu of Qi to raise numinous martial power, cut down many hardships, rehung sun and moon, rejoined the Three Stars, swept the ancestral temple, and remade the state by the enterprise — a vast merit beyond words.
idiomatic: We relied on Prince Xianwu of Qi to raise numinous martial power, cut down many hardships, rehung sun and moon, rejoined the Three Stars, swept the ancestral temple, and remade the state by the enterprise — a vast merit beyond words.

literal: When Wenxiang took up the structure, the enterprise grew still broader; near was soothed and far submitted, within the seas were tranquil; the fate of the state was already secure and the living found their nature.
idiomatic: When Gao Cheng took up the structure, the enterprise grew still broader; near was soothed and far submitted, within the seas were tranquil; the fate of the state was already secure and the living found their nature.

literal: Down to the Prince of Qi as Grand Chancellor, weaving letters and threading martial power, holding this great enterprise, exhausting wisdom and probing the subtle, studying the deep and measuring transformation — thought followed dark fortune, wisdom moved with the spirit; kindness matched spring heaven, awe matched summer sun; level heart reached the myriad things, the Great Way was spread to the eight directions; therefore the hundred officials were orderly, the court without bad government, the net sparse and the marsh rich, and all under heaven returned their hearts.
idiomatic: Down to the Prince of Qi as Grand Chancellor, weaving letters and threading martial power, holding this great enterprise, exhausting wisdom and probing the subtle, studying the deep and measuring transformation — thought followed dark fortune, wisdom moved with the spirit; kindness matched spring heaven, awe matched summer sun; level heart reached the myriad things, the Great Way was spread to the eight directions; therefore the hundred officials were orderly, the court without bad government, the net sparse and the marsh rich, and all under heaven returned their hearts.

literal: Without, he exhausted the Yangtze and Huai; wind bowed and knees bent; opening land and cherishing men, a hundred cities ran; Guan and Long admired righteousness and asked for friendship; the boundless desert looked up to virtue and showed sincerity.
idiomatic: Without, he exhausted the Yangtze and Huai; wind bowed and knees bent; opening land and cherishing men, a hundred cities ran; Guan and Long admired righteousness and asked for friendship; the boundless desert looked up to virtue and showed sincerity.

literal: What is called a life answering the age truly comforts a thousand years.
idiomatic: What is called a life answering the age truly comforts a thousand years.

literal: Auspicious tokens crowded in confusion, strange things on the same road; songs of praise piled up, different regions with one accord — the trace of dynastic end was already shown, the covenant of human and numinous already joined; heaven's Way is not far — We alone do not know.
idiomatic: Auspicious tokens crowded in confusion, strange things on the same road; songs of praise piled up, different regions with one accord — the trace of dynastic end was already shown, the covenant of human and numinous already joined; heaven's Way is not far — We alone do not know.

literal: We entered to receive the vast blessing and will inherit the age's sacrifice; relying on the thickness of established aid, extending the altar's span — speaking quietly of the great fortune, We rejoice in yielding to the worthy; far pondering the canon of abdication of Tang and Yu, near recalling the wind of bowing and yielding of Wei and Jin — how can We obscure the rites of rise and fall and examine the hope of spirits and gods?
idiomatic: We entered to receive the vast blessing and will inherit the age's sacrifice; relying on the thickness of established aid, extending the altar's span — speaking quietly of the great fortune, We rejoice in yielding to the worthy; far pondering the canon of abdication of Tang and Yu, near recalling the wind of bowing and yielding of Wei and Jin — how can We obscure the rites of rise and fall and examine the hope of spirits and gods?

literal: Now We at once yield to the separate palace and return the imperial seat to the state of Qi, pushing the sage and giving ability, faintly matching the former track.
idiomatic: Now We at once yield to the separate palace and return the imperial seat to the state of Qi, pushing the sage and giving ability, faintly matching the former track.

literal: The chief officer shall proclaim throughout the realm and implement it in season.
idiomatic: The chief officer shall proclaim throughout the realm and implement it in season.

literal: Again he sent Acting Grand Commandant Prince of Pengcheng Shao and Acting Minister of Works Jing Xianjun to present the register, saying:
idiomatic: Again he sent Acting Grand Commandant Prince of Pengcheng Gao Shao and Acting Minister of Works Jing Xianjun to present the register, saying:

literal: Consult you, Grand Chancellor Prince of Qi: Qi divided and forms transformed, things depend on a lord and elder; sovereign and king rise in turn — men are not of one surname.
idiomatic: Consult you, Grand Chancellor Prince of Qi: Qi divided and forms transformed, things depend on a lord and elder; sovereign and king rise in turn — men are not of one surname.

literal: In former times Yao governed the age and sank the jade disc, entrusting it to his son;
idiomatic: In former times Yao governed the age and sank the jade disc, entrusting it to his son;

literal: Shun grasped the calendar, held the balance and embraced the jade pivot.
idiomatic: Shun grasped the calendar, held the balance and embraced the jade pivot.

literal: Therefore heroic and worthy, abundant in reality, shone clearly through a thousand ages — how is it that flourishing and decline have a fortune, rise and fall lie in the time, knowing fate cannot but be granted, fearing heaven cannot but be received?
idiomatic: Therefore heroic and worthy, abundant in reality, shone clearly through a thousand ages — how is it that flourishing and decline have a fortune, rise and fall lie in the time, knowing fate cannot but be granted, fearing heaven cannot but be received?

literal: Thus Han Liu reported ill fortune, Dangtu followed the people; Cao's calendar was not long, the Metal line received abdication — all these repeated the measure and followed the square, proceeding by the old canon.
idiomatic: Thus Han Liu reported ill fortune, Dangtu followed the people; Cao's calendar was not long, the Metal line received abdication — all these repeated the measure and followed the square, proceeding by the old canon.

literal: Our clan ancestors illuminated the dwelling and unified the ten thousand realms.
idiomatic: Our clan ancestors illuminated the dwelling and unified the ten thousand realms.
